contexts.text: To walk on the belly () = not to be able to look upwards to heavenly things.
To walk with God () = the doctrine of faith. ( = to teach and live according to the doctrine of faith; but to walk with Jehovah = to live a life of love. AC 519.) AC 614.

To walk is an accustomed formula which = to live; as to walk in the law, in the statutes, in the Truth. To walk properly regards the way, which is of Truth, consequently which is of faith, that is, the doctrine of faith. Illustrated.
The walkings... of Spirits... are nothing but changes of state. Explained. AC 9927:2. SE 5646, General article. LJPost 197, Example(s).
Arise, walk through the land () = that He should thoroughly view the Heavenly Kingdom.
(The walks of good and angelic Spirits. Described.) HH 176. HH 489:4. CL 326. TCR 280.
I am walking childless () = that there is no internal Church. To walk = to live.

When walking through the streets and fields, and at the same time in speech with Spirits, I knew no otherwise than that I was as awake as at other times, for I walked without a mistake, and was at the same time in vision... But after I had so walked for hours, suddenly I was in the bodily sight, and found myself in a different place, which amazed me. Explained. HH 441.
Walk before Me () = the truth of faith; for to walk = to live according to the truth of faith. (Moreover) a way, of which walking is predicated, = truth.
To walk in the name of its god () = profane worship; and to walk in the name of Jehovah () = true worship.

What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? () = exploration concerning the Rational, which was in good alone... Its being in good is signified by walking, that is, meditating, in the field.
For I have walked in the spirit with and among (Spirits), through many of their abodes, although as to the body I remained in the same place.
If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not; but if any man walk in the night, he stumbleth... ()... To walk in the day = to live in truth; and to walk in the night = to live in falsity.
God, before whom my fathers did walk () = the Divine from whom internal good and internal truth had life... To walk = to live, or to have life.
(Our Lord seen walking among the inhabitants of Venus.)
The fire walked on the earth () = ... the natural mind possessed (by cupidities) down to its lowest parts. AC 7577.
(How the inhabitants of Jupiter walk.) Described. AC 8372. AC 8374. SE 520. SE 559. SE 567. SE 582. SE 586.

Whether they walk in My law... () = whether they can live the life of truth and good. To walk = to live... In the very word to walk there is the signification of the spiritual sense, as in very many other words. Explained.
If he arise and walk abroad upon his crutch () = the forces of life in him... To walk = to live.
To walk = to live.
The grandiose style of walking in the First Earth. Described.
To walk = to live according to truths.
To walk = life.
Innocence and peace walk with equal step.
In the other life... everyone walks according to his thoughts which proceed from intention... Illustrated.
Hence it is that... to walk, etc. in the Word, = progressions of life.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. That to go, and to walk, with the Lord = to receive spiritual life, and to live with Him. References.
In the Angelic there is a Knowledge of the way from a walking in it, and a walking in the way through the Knowledge of it.
Walking in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks () = from whom is all enlightenment... It is said walking, because to walk = to live. AE 97.
To carry the bed, and walk () = to meditate on doctrine.
They love only to walk, sleep, etc.

They shall walk with Me in white () = that they will live with the Lord in His Spiritual Kingdom, because they are in truths from Him. To walk, in the Word, = to live; and to walk with God = to live from Him. AR 167:2. Illustrated. ( = their spiritual life which they have through the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word. AE 196.) ( = to follow the Lord, and to live according to the truths of His Word. TCR 682:2.)

Which can neither see, hear, nor walk () = in which there is nothing of spiritual and truly rational life... To walk = to live. ( = in which and from which there is nothing of understanding of truth nor perception of good, and thus nothing of spiritual life. AE 588.)
To walk naked () = to live without truths. AE 1008.

The nations which are saved shall walk in the light of it () = that all who are in the good of life, and believe in the Lord, will live therein according to Divine truths, and will see these things within themselves.
The promenade of the palace.
Like sleep-walkers. Compare SE 5968.
Such persons... walk as if oppressed with heaviness, with the head hanging down...
When Melancthon walks, his steps make a knocking sound. Described. Compare SE 6040.
The magnificent walks in one of the Earths. Described.
Some appeared to be standing in their place who told me that they were walking.
The reflections which cause man... to take care of himself when walking. (Example under reflect.) See also SE 4221. SE 4226.

When the Angels see any Spirit walking below them, they at once perceive from the way in which he walks-via ambulationis, and its windings... what his quality is, and of what he is thinking... No one can learn by heart how to walk according to the heavenly form. Explained.
When men walk, it is indeed with the body, but it is actually from the will; and the man's walking is in proportion to the amount of will there is present...
The walkings there are either total or partial changes. Explained.
From the walkings and the ways of Rosenstolpe, (his real character) did not appear...
To walk = to act and to live.

That to walk = to live; and, when predicated of the Lord, life itself, is from the appearances in the Spiritual World; for there all walk according to their life, the evil in those ways only which lead to Hell, and the good in those ways only which lead to Heaven; and therefore all Spirits are Known from the ways in which they walk. Explained.
That to walk = to live. Illustrated. AE 239:20. AE 283:8. AE 422:13. AE 430:16. AE 453:11. AE 526:11. AE 594:10. AE 750:23.
Take up thy bed and walk () = doctrine, and a life according to it.
To walk in His ways () = to do the commandments. ( = to live according to Divine truths. AE 696:13.)

The Lord's walking upon the sea (; ) = the presence and influx of the Lord into these ultimates, and thus life from the Divine in those who are in the ultimates of Heaven; their life from the Divine was represented by the walking of the Lord upon the sea; and their obscure and wavering faith was represented by the fact that Peter, walking upon the sea, began to sink... for to walk, in the Word, = to live.
To walk on these places (there), is dangerous for those who are merely natural. Explained.
To walk before God = to live according to the esse from Him. AE 687:5.
Walkings and journeyings are movements of man, and therefore = the progression of life, that is, the progression of the thought from the intention of the will.
Thou hast walked in the midst of the stones of fire () = the truths from the good of love according to which is the life.

In the Word it is said... to go, and to walk, after God, after other gods, after a leader, and after many, and by this is signified to follow and acknowledge at heart, and also to be and to live with them, and to be consociated. Illustrated.
To gird, and to walk () = to learn truths, and to live according to them...
To go, and to walk, after the Lord = to acknowledge, obey, do, and live from Him and with Him.
Taking walks as a diversion of charity. Explained.
